name: run-sheet
title: Event run sheet
for_each: select id,name from events.events order by starts_on

sections.title: Sessions (UTC)
sections.sql: select name,room,starts_at,ends_at,speaker,booked from events.session_capacity where event_id=$1 order by starts_at,room

name: speaker-brief
title: Speaker briefing checklist
for_each: select id,name from events.events order by starts_on

sections.title: Speakers
sections.sql: select name,owner,brief_due,brief_received from events.speakers where event_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Programme (UTC)
sections.sql: select name,room,starts_at,ends_at,speaker from events.session_capacity where event_id=$1 order by starts_at

name: sponsor-delivery
title: Sponsor fulfilment record
for_each: select id,name from events.events order by starts_on

sections.title: Commitments
sections.sql: select sponsor,item,owner,due_on,status,evidence from events.deliverables where event_id=$1 order by sponsor,due_on

name: attendance-sheet
title: Attendance sheet: internal use
for_each: select id,name from events.events order by starts_on

sections.title: Registrations
sections.note: Contains personal information. Share only with authorised event staff.
sections.sql: select name,company,status,checked_in_at from events.registrants where event_id=$1 and status='confirmed' order by name
